definitions.explanation: The act of pulling or towing a vessel, vehicle, or object by another. Most commonly used in maritime contexts for ships towing other ships, but also applicable to general towing situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曳航|えいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
タグボート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧タンカー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{曳航|えいこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A tugboat towed the large tanker to the port.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪天候|あくてんこう}→悪天候：16184_akutenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曳航|えいこう}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧。
examples.english: Towing operations in bad weather involve danger.

notes:
Written with the character {曳|えい} (to pull, to drag) and {航|こう} (navigation, voyage). Primarily a maritime and nautical term, though it can also apply to aircraft or land vehicles. Can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({曳航|えいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {曳航|えいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tow
- {曳航|えいこう}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: towing operation
- {曳航|えいこう}⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧: towline, tow rope
- {曳航|えいこう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: under tow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{牽引|けんいん}→牽引：13498_kenin⟧: traction, pulling — broader term used for land vehicles and general pulling force
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧: to pull — everyday word for pulling something toward oneself
